title: 第七章  污蔑皇子，可是死罪！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“大皇子，六皇子视同水火！”

“陛下岂能不知！”

“陛下如今身体抱恙，若在明旨处理我林家！”

“他难道就不怕祸起萧墙！”

月璇玑瞳孔猛地一缩。

“祸起萧墙！”

每个字都像钉子一样钉进月璇玑心里！

“娘子，你读过那么多史书，应当知道历朝历代参与党争的下场。

“陛下现在，怕是被这两个皇子弄得有点睡不着觉了。”

月璇玑眉毛一挑。

她出自皇家，这道理她自然懂！

林家就是父皇身边的一把刀。

用来分化，制衡。

可她却实在忍受不了与这个废物同在一个屋檐下继续生活。

这次说什么也得退了这桩婚....

“我不管，我只给你三日时间考虑！”

“要么签休书，要么接受我母后的怒火！”

“你好自为之！”

“是吗？”

林澈眼眸之中闪过一丝寒光！

“到底谁接受谁的怒火还尤为可知！”

说完，林澈转身就走，甩袖的动作干脆利落。

月璇玑看着他的背影，气得把茶杯摔了个粉碎。

“放肆！简直放肆！”

........

此时此刻，皇宫乾清宫内，灯火通明。

皇帝月天坐在龙椅上，脸上并无一丝病态。

皇后侯婉茹坐在一旁，手里的帕子绞了又绞，脸上倒是挂着温柔的笑容，但那双眼睛里，一丝温度都没有。

“林家这个庶子太不知廉耻！”

“我好心好意不追究他跟宫女私通的事儿，还给他体面让他签休书，他倒好，不识抬举！”

月天只是淡淡看了一眼皇后道；

“既然林澈不识好歹，朕就按规矩办就是了。”

“他犯了错，该治罪治罪，该砍头砍头.....”

“这是天经地义的事儿。”

“可他若是被人冤枉，又当如何？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"The eldest prince and the sixth princes are treated as fire and water!"

"How could your Majesty not know!"

"Your Majesty is in ill health now. If you are willing to deal with my Lin family!"

"Isn't he afraid of causing trouble to Xiao Qiang?"

Yue Xuanji's pupils shrank suddenly.

"Misfortune starts with Xiao Qiang!"

Every word was driven into Yue Xuanji's heart like a nail!

"Madam, you have read so many history books, you should know the consequences of participating in party strife in the past dynasties.

"Your Majesty, I am afraid that these two princes have made it difficult to sleep."

Yue Xuanji raised her eyebrows.

She comes from the royal family, so she understands this!

The Lin family is a knife by the father's side.

Used to differentiate and check and balance.

But she really couldn't bear to continue living under the same roof with this trash.

This time I have to break off the marriage no matter what I do...

"I don't care, I only give you three days to think about it!"

“Either sign the divorce papers or accept my mother’s wrath!"

"You take care of yourself!"

"Yeah?"

A cold light flashed in Lin Che's eyes!

“It’s still unclear who accepts whose anger!"

After saying that, Lin Che turned around and left, flicking her sleeves neatly.

Yue Xuanji looked at his back and was so angry that she smashed the teacup.

"Presumptuous!How presumptuous!"

........

At this moment, the lights in the Imperial Palace Qianqing Palace were brightly lit.

Emperor Yuetian sat on the dragon chair, with no trace of illness on his face.

Queen Hou Wanru sat aside, twisting the handkerchief again and again, with a gentle smile on her face, but there was no warmth in her eyes.

"This bastard of the Lin family is so shameless!"

"I had good intentions and didn't pursue his affair with the palace maid, and I gave him the dignity to sign the divorce papers. It's good for him, he doesn't know how to flatter me!"

Yue Tian just glanced at the Queen lightly and said;

"Since Lin Che doesn't know good from evil, I will just follow the rules."

"He made a mistake and deserves to be punished and beheaded..."

“This is a matter of course."

“But what if he is wronged?"
